chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 249: The Demon Sect Founder Backs Xiao Chen, Tiger Demigods Fall
chapter_meta_description: The Demon Sect Founder publicly supports Xiao Chen, leading to the swift annihilation of three Tiger clan demigods by twenty young experts. A comedy of errors unfolds with a Three Realms Bag as Xiao Chen departs for a floating island.
og_description: The Demon Sect Founder's return reshapes power dynamics as Xiao Chen gains an unstoppable patron. Three half-gods die in moments, and a stuttering assassin schemes for profit.
twitter_description: The Demon Sect Founder backs Xiao Chen. Tiger demigods are killed by twenty young experts. Comedy and chaos ensue with a Three Realms Bag.
